root_cause.summary: Personal LinkedIn authorization trusted caller-supplied identity booleans and shallow first-person tokens; business/thought-leadership copy could therefore be wrapped with 'ik', 'mijn', 'vandaag' or 'weekend' and still look personal upstream.

prevention.rule: Fail closed on the exact final copy. Arthur personal LinkedIn requires a concrete lived personal event in the text itself and blocks business, consultant/thought-leadership and forced-business-moral signals regardless of upstream flags.
prevention.regression_contract: linkedin_personal final-copy semantics must be evaluated at pre-publish time; metadata can strengthen evidence but cannot replace semantic evidence in the final text.

historical_replay: Ik denk vandaag na over hoe je processen slimmer maakt.
Mijn weekendgedachte: leiderschap gaat over strategie concreet maken.
Ik stond thuis vanochtend ruzie te maken met mijn printer. Volgens mij wint hij.
